scope: A blank contract is rendered as PENDING, never invented. MFL records only the SALARY on a waiver/FCFS award and leaves contractStatus/contractYear/contractInfo empty; the roster-workbench rookie fallback was reading that silence as a rookie deal and manufacturing a 2-year / $2,000 contract (Brashard Smith). The fallback now requires MFL to actually say the contract is a rookie one, and any row MFL has not described renders TCV/CL/Yrs/AAV/GTD/penalty as "pending" with a PENDING chip instead of a fabricated shape or the red EXPIRED chip. Such a row still counts its real salary against the cap and against roster limits.
